ऊति: ūtí, f. furtherance, help, blessing; refreshment,  food. [√av, 1157.]
ऊधन्: ū́dhan, ū́dhar, ū́dhas [430b], n. udder. [cf. οὖθαρ, Lat. ūber, AS. ūder, Eng. udder.]
ऊन: ūná, a. lacking. [cf. εὖνις, ‘bereft’; AS. wan, ‘lacking,’ wanian, ‘decrease,’ Eng. wane.]
ऊरु: ūrú, m. thigh. [prob. ‘the thick’ of the leg, from urú.]
ऊर्ज्: ū́rj, f. sap; strength; vigor; nourishment. [√*varj, ‘swell with, be full of’: cf. ὀργάω, ‘swell with, abound’; Lat. virga, ‘swelling twig.’]
ऊर्ण: ūrṇa, n., and ū́rṇā, f. wool. [‘cover,’ √1vṛ, ‘cover’ (cf. 712): cf. εἶρος, *ἐ-ϝρ-ος, Lat. vellus, Goth. vulla, Eng. wool.]
ऊर्णम्रदस्: ū́rṇa-mradas, a. having the softness of wool, soft as wool.
ऊर्णास्तुका: ūrṇā-stukā, f. braid or plait of wool.
ऊर्ध्व: ūrdhvá, a. tending upwards; upright; elevated; -am, as adv., upwards; over; beyond; after, w. abl. [1128]; ata ūrdhvam, from now on. [cf. Lat. arduus, ‘lofty.’]
ऊर्ध्वदृष्टि: ūrdhva-dṛṣṭi, a. having an upward gaze. [1298.]
ऊर्मि: ūrmí, m. wave. [lit. ‘roller, rolling billow, ’ √*vṛ, ‘roll, turn hither and thither’: cf. ὀραγάω, Lat. volvo, ‘roll’; Ger. Welle, ‘wave.’]
ऊह्: √2ūh (óhate [745a]; ūhé; aúhīt, aúhiṣṭa; ū́hitum; -ū́hya). notice. + api, grasp; understand, 8810.
